name: Alfa Romeo 158/47
description:
T158 "Alfetta", 1947 works specification: 8 cyl in-line 58 * 70 mm = 1479 cc, 2 valves/cyl, single-stage Roots supercharger, 275 bhp @ 7500 rpm (195 bhp in 1938, 225 in 1939, 254 on the car's return in 1946, 310 by 1948)

Design: Gioachino Colombo
Transmission: 4 speed gearbox integral with rear axle
Chassis: Tubular frame
Suspension: Front: Trailing arm, transverse leaf springs, hydraulic dampers Rear: Swing axle, transverse leaf spring, hydraulic dampers
Dimensions: Wheelbase: 2500mm Track: 1270mm
Years: 1946-51

The Alfettas spent the war hidden in a cheese factory at Melzo and came back in 1946 to a Grand Prix formula - 1.5 litres supercharged against 4.5 unblown - that could have been written for them. Alfa Corse entered eleven races between 1946 and 1948 and won all eleven. The 158 was still winning in 1951, by then making 425 bhp and about a mile and a half to the gallon.
author: Legion
